captions.detailed: An under-desk air purifier featuring a flat, low-profile rectangular housing in a light gray finish. The front face features a dark, slotted intake grille, while the top has a single small black circular control button. The bottom panel of the unit is designed to swing open on a front-edge revolute hinge, allowing an inner filter drawer to slide out horizontally on prismatic rails.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an under-desk air purifier with a low-profile rectangular main housing, a front grille face, a top button, and an articulated bottom panel that hinges open to reveal a sliding filter drawer.
captions.factory: Construct the main body housing from a hollowed-out Box primitive with a front opening. Model the front grille using a thin box with arrayed slot cutouts. Create the bottom door as a flat plate and attach it to the main housing with a revolute joint along the front bottom edge. Model the inner filter drawer using a shallow box with a central hollow, and attach it to the bottom door via a prismatic joint to represent the sliding rails.
